description: Agent-first OrcaRouter gateway access — model catalog, chat completions, auth health, and doctor diagnostics for the OpenAI-compatible OrcaRouter endpoint.
auth_description: API key from your OrcaRouter dashboard

novel_features.name: Gateway health check
novel_features.description: Verify auth, config, and live connectivity to the OrcaRouter gateway in one command — probes /models and reports reachability plus model count.

novel_features.name: Model catalog
novel_features.description: List the full OrcaRouter model namespace (orcarouter/* plus routed provider models) with context length, sorted for agent-friendly scanning.

novel_features.name: Model lookup
novel_features.description: Show a single OrcaRouter model by id including supported endpoint types and context length.

novel_features.name: OpenAI-compatible chat
novel_features.description: Send a chat completion to any OrcaRouter model through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint with --max-tokens and --temperature, JSON output under --agent.

novel_features.name: Auth state
novel_features.description: Show whether the CLI is configured, the auth source (env or config), and the target base URL — plus auth set to persist an API key to the local config.
